approved: Frames D1/D2, layout, lighting and slot list approved 2026-10-08 (verbatim: "סבב 2 נראה מעולה", on assets/blockout/house/framing/round2/all-round2.jpg) together with the density decision (verbatim: "כתוב מינימום מוצרים..לדעתי כמה שיותר שהמעצב יחליט שזה לא גורע. ו3 וואריציות מתאימות לנורדי לכל מוצר"). step-stool is a designer addition under that decision (not in the clay; first to go if busy). Rules: docs/design-bible/nordic.md 1.6 + docs/design-bible/nordic-dining.md 0.2; geometry: docs/house-plan.md/json 1.1. Replaces 0.1 (single frame D0, 12 slots).
notes: Same structure as living-room.json, extended for two frames. Both frames share camera point PD, so ONE z-order serves both (same centre of projection). frames = the master frames in which the product is visible by design; density.not_counted lists the in-frame products that miss the Bible 1.6 counting rule. placement uses the product-card enum (floor, wall, window, surface, sofa, ceiling); placement_detail names the surface. z = layer order bottom to top; a product's shadow sits at z-1 unless has_shadow_layer is false. plan_m = position in house coordinates (docs/house-plan.json), Z from the floor. envelope_cm = maximum envelope per variant; the 3 variants stay within +-15%. hotspot and zoom_frame are set after the shell render. fillers = unsold contents (Bible 1.5), identical in all variants. set_of = each variant is a set of that many pieces. status_0_2 marks what changed.

D2.hero: plastered hood u 0.328; coffee niche u 0.695

density.rule: Bible 1.6 S11: minimum 14 per full-route frame is a floor; as many products as the designer judges do not detract. Counted = >= 0.1% of the frame and >= 50% visible, or a decisively cut large textile with >= 1% visible.
